{
  "name": "sidequest",
  "version": "5.7.0",
  "description": "The Loadout's core work board and orchestration loop for Claude Code. Tickets are classified into categories that route each one to a concrete model and effort, then dispatched to token-gated executors; side issues you mention mid-task get captured on the spot, and a live, self-hosted Kanban dashboard spans every project you work in.",
  "author": {
    "name": "poindexter12"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/poindexter12/loadout/tree/main/plugins/sidequest",
  "repository": "https://github.com/poindexter12/loadout",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "tickets",
    "kanban",
    "trello",
    "board",
    "issues",
    "todo",
    "dashboard",
    "hooks",
    "capture"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "compactionGuard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Compaction guard",
      "description": "Keeps dispatch and briefing results when a third-party compaction plugin (fast-jev-compaction) replaces the transcript. off: nothing runs. auto: acts once a compaction plugin shows up beneath sidequest. on: always pins and restores. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1, with sidequest@loadout in prependPlugins.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "auto",
        "on"
      ],
      "default": "off"
    }
  }
}
